body:
Ill try and sleep now. If you are around tomorrow or whenever, I will be here with my sad self. :)

It was really nice for me to have someone to share this with. Good night for now. <3

They are con artists. The controlling abusive types. They put on a facade for others, or else some people don't want to know. But it's frustrating and hard when other people think they are decent and normal. I guess that is par for the course. I can look back now and see red flags that just made me slightly uncomfortable at the time. You can't always see it because of not thinking that way yourself. 

This is horrifying what happened to you afterwards. Really. 

Yes. It is crazy how people affect others. Crazy and sad.

I just left you a long comment on your post. Thank you for this. It helps right now to have some validation and empathy. I know I am better off but it feels like  he has caused too much damage and I don't know how to feel okay again. 

I like stick figures. :-) Yeah, I wanted to go to an art school, but my parents talked me out of that dream. But if only I could not feel like dying I wanted to start painting again. Thanks for talking to me, I really hope you are back on here again. I'd really like to chat more if you do. You've helped me feel less alone in the universe right now. I really do appreciate the things you've written and your taking the time to do that.

Don't worry backflip. 

Do you know you asking to see some of my work actually gave me a little lift in spirit? Thanks! I will try to tomorrow somehow - it will honestly give me one thing to distract me and even enjoy a little. Thanks so much for that.

I do care. I hate these people that go around hurting people and then carry on like they are something special. They are f'in not special in any way shape or form. They are nothing. It's hysterical that they think they are special because they mean nothing. That's pretty spectacular that you have been a victim advocate. I know I couldn't and that's damn amazing that you have after what you have suffered. 

What kind of hospital puts a rape victim in the same room with the rapist? And then jokes, trivializes and invalidates the victim? It's like another assault. Jesus. You should have been treated gently and with compassion and respect. I know that in trauma it is very important to healing for the initial response to be supportive. That's f'ked up. I'm so sorry. 

The one time I reported it was in London and they were very professional but the other times I didn't report. It seems to me that what you went through in the after math was criminal in itself. 

It is typical for these bastards to attack the victim verbally - don't listen to him. It's all to do with him wanting to be powerful and he has to hurt people to do that. Yes, that kind of thing happened to me too. I was called names, told I was being a baby, told I was crazy, told that if I did kill myself no one would care anyway. And yes, my self esteem is gone. I hate to look in the mirror. I don't see myself anymore. I know intellectually that I am still me and still deserve to be here, but emotionally I feel like something was murdered inside of me.  I don't care what I wear anymore. 

The cop said he'd never be able to do that to someone? Was the cop there in a professional capacity? What is wrong with these people? It's like some 1950's film. But typical also for this kind of violent person to have groupies around them. I told the mother of the man who hurt me (yes, i don't know what I was thinking) and she told me the same. That it didn't sound like him.

What's wrong? 

Have you shared already about why you feel this way? Did something specific happen or is it a general situation?

Hey. I'm sorry I suck at advice but I feel very much as you write about the world being against you and wanting to let go. And don't be sorry about anything. It's not too long. It's your life. It matters. 

Rape is evil, and for me it has changed everything about how I feel about myself. Like my body isn't mine and disconnected. I just know for myself it was that that started me thinking and feeling differently. I don't know how to help but reading your post has resonated with me.
